title: 第8章 入内门，择灵司
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

辞别林师兄，离开正炁殿，陆玄没有返回蛰院精舍，而是直接化为流光，越过了层层山峦，朝着北方一处地界而去。

不多时，茫茫云雾之中，出现了一座悬空殿宇。

此殿巍巍哉二十余丈，占云数亩，飞檐如凤展翅，碧瓦金柱，内中上下空间极为宽广，好似巨灵神仙之居所，不似凡人之地。

殿宇金匾之上，上书三个大字：抡才殿。

鉴天教鉴定弟子潜力，主掌收录真传、内门、外门之所。

此殿除去殿中值守特制的【抡才青云】外，普通的【小青霓云】无法腾空至此，唯有凭借自身遁光。

说白了，炼炁之下的修士，不可进入此殿。

除非由殿中值守统一带领。

若是陆玄愿意转修金甲玉躯，七日期限满了之后，就会被领到此地，颁发外门弟子玉碟。

但今日他自腾云至此，意义自然不同了。

此时虽刚刚天明，但抡才殿早有值守忙碌其中。

四日之后，外门弟子一百余人将要录入玉碟，领道袍法剑，准备工作繁琐，不可懈怠。

但迎来送往，乃是值守的本职，故而陆玄刚入此殿正门之前，就有一青年值守发现了他。

这值守亦是胎息之境，但目光敏锐，见到了陆玄的云炁虹光，当即就知晓这是一位炼炁得成的弟子，同时陆玄腰间的蛰院玉符也被他收入眼底。

当即心中惊疑不定，可还是连忙迎了上来，恭敬的问道：“侍选此时至此，不知有何要事？”

“我于今日天明大醮功成，得成炼炁，故而前来，想录入内门玉碟。”

陆玄打了一个稽首，道出了来意。

“大醮功成？”

这值守一愣，殿中正在忙碌的其余几位值守也是一怔，纷纷抬首看来。

蛰院弟子大醮早就结束了，该入内门的也早就入了内门，此刻大醮功成？

这是……自行大醮，二次功成？

竟然真的有二次大醮成功者？

这样的例子太过少见，鉴天教在擎岳州传承三十代，也至多五指之数罢了，这一代给他们遇上了？

“还请师兄稍待，饮一杯灵茶，我这就去请执事。”

但这值守反应极快，当即打了一个眼色，让同僚侍候陆玄，自己则是快速进入后殿。

平日里，鉴天教任何殿宇教所都是由这些【凡人值守】看护打理，唯有要事，才会有真正修为高深的【执事】前来处理。

脱产修行，是大教弟子的标配。

但也不是所有弟子都可脱产，寻常内门炼炁弟子，也要有所“劳役”，如此才可得道禄，供养己身。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After bidding farewell to Senior Brother Lin and leaving Zhengqi Hall, Lu Xuan did not return to Zheyuan Jingshe, but directly turned into a stream of light, crossing the mountains and heading towards a boundary in the north.

Not long after, a suspended palace appeared in the vast clouds and mist.

This majestic palace is more than twenty feet tall and covers several acres. It has eaves like a phoenix spreading its wings, green tiles and golden pillars. The upper and lower spaces inside are extremely wide. It is like the residence of giant spirits and gods, not like a place for mortals.

On the golden plaque of the palace, there are three characters: Luancai Palace.

The Jiantian Sect evaluates the potential of its disciples and is in charge of collecting the true biography, the inner sect, and the outer sect.

Except for the specially-made [Branding Blue Clouds] on duty in this hall, the ordinary [Little Qingni Clouds] cannot fly up to this point, and can only escape the light by themselves.

To put it bluntly, monks who are under the power of refining are not allowed to enter this hall.

Unless they are led by the guards in the palace.

If Lu Xuan is willing to cultivate the golden armor and jade body, after the seven-day period is up, he will be taken here and awarded the jade plate to the outer disciples.

But today, since he has reached this point, the meaning is naturally different.

Although it was just dawn at this time, there were already guards on duty at Luancai Hall who were busy there.

Four days later, more than a hundred outer disciples will be registered on the jade plate and receive Taoist robes and magic swords. The preparation work is tedious and cannot be slacked off.

But it is the duty of the guard to welcome people and send them off, so before Lu Xuan entered the main entrance of this palace, a young guard discovered him.

This guard was also in the state of fetal breath, but his eyesight was sharp. When he saw Lu Xuan's cloud Qi rainbow light, he immediately knew that this was a disciple who had achieved Qi refining. At the same time, he also caught the jade talisman of the dormitory around Lu Xuan's waist.

Immediately, I was shocked and confused, but I still hurriedly came forward and asked respectfully: "You are here now. What important matters do you have?"

"I completed the great ceremony at dawn today and was able to refine Qi, so I came here and wanted to record it on the inner jade disc."

Lu Xuan made a gesture and revealed his intention.

"Is the Great Jiao successful?"

The guard was startled, and the other guards who were busy in the palace were also startled, and they all looked up.

The disciples of Zheyuan have finished the great ceremony long ago, and those who should enter the inner gate have also entered the inner gate long ago. Now the great ceremony is completed?

This is... a self-made ritual, a second success?

Is there really a person who succeeded in the second wedding ceremony?

Such examples are too rare. The Jiantian Sect has been passed down in Qingyue Prefecture for thirty generations, at most five fingers. Did they encounter this generation?

"Please wait a moment, senior brother, for a cup of spiritual tea. I'll go and ask for the deacon right away."

But the guard reacted very quickly. He immediately winked and asked his colleagues to wait on Lu Xuan, while he quickly entered the back hall.

On weekdays, all the temples and temples of the Jiantian Sect are guarded and managed by these [Mortal Guards]. Only for important matters, will the [Deacons] with truly advanced cultivation come to handle them.

Free-time practice is the standard for disciples of great religions.

But not all disciples can get out of work. Ordinary inner sect Qi refining disciples also have to do some "labor", so that they can obtain Taoism and support themselves.
